items: TLC na-maloom compounds ki Rf values ko maloom standard values se mila kar unhein pehchanti hai.
TLC se kisi substance ki purity (khalis hona) check ki ja sakti hai.
Reaction kitna aage barha, yani reactants khatam ho rahe hain ya products ban rahe hain, yeh TLC se check hota hai.

Pharmaceutical (dawaiyan banane ki) aur food (khurak ki) industry mein TLC se dawaiyon ki purity, aur khurak mein preservatives (kharab hone se bachane wali cheezein), colourants (rang) aur sweeteners (meethi cheezein) check kiye jate hain.
TLC mitti, paani, khurak aur hawa mein pollutants, pesticides (keere maar dawaiyan) aur toxic (zehreeli) cheezein bhi dhoond sakti hai.
Forensic science mein TLC jurm ki jagah par drugs, dhamake ke baad ka malba (post blast debris), khoon, paseena aur semen pehchanne mein kaam aati hai.

blocks.text: Kitab application (v) mein 'TCL' likhti hai; sahi naam TLC (thin layer chromatography) hai.
